stories.sz: 据报道，由于伊朗支持的胡塞武装取得进展令海湾国家统治者感到恐慌，阿联酋将恢复对也门部队的资金支持。也门内战：最新升级的导火索是什么，各方涉及谁？阿拉伯联合酋长国已同意……

stories.t: Russia wants blackout in Ukraine as winter comes — Zelenskyy
stories.s: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy says Russia is trying to cut electricity and heating to civilians ahead of winter. He also called the US president's waiver of new sanctions on Moscow a boost for Vladimir Putin.
stories.tz: 泽连斯基称：随着冬季来临，俄罗斯蓄意在乌克兰制造全面黑暗
stories.sz: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯正试图在冬季到来前切断平民的电力和暖气供应。他还称美国总统豁免对莫斯科的新制裁是对弗拉基米尔·普京的支持。

stories.t: Decades after apartheid, South Africans seek justice for crimes of the past
stories.s: More than three decades after the end of apartheid, families of victims of some of the worst crimes of South Africa's past are still fighting for justice. As survivors and perpetrators grow older, a new wave of legal efforts is seeking…
stories.tz: 种族隔离制度结束几十年后，南非人寻求为过去罪行伸张正义
stories.sz: 南非种族隔离制度结束三十多年后，该国一些最严重罪行受害者家属仍在为正义而战。随着幸存者和肇事者日渐年迈，新一波法律行动正在寻求……

stories.t: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
stories.s: The French royal jewel will be on public display for the first time since it was found hidden in an apple after a 1926 theft.
stories.tz: 业余盗窃案发生100年后，罕见粉钻在法国展出
stories.sz: 这枚法国皇家珠宝自1926年盗窃案后被藏在苹果中被发现以来，将首次向公众展出。

stories.t: Teacher fought US school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
stories.s: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.
stories.tz: 美国校园枪击案中教师勇敢搏斗，持枪父亲随后将嫌疑人“多次击中”
stories.sz: 警方称，这名16岁的嫌疑人曾就读于该小学，并将袭击目标锁定在一个特殊教育需求教室。

stories.t: Katie Zacharia leaving White House role less than five days into job
stories.s: Her public debut as press secretary ended with a flurry of media criticism about her credentials and preparedness.
stories.tz: 凯蒂·扎卡里亚上任不到五天即卸任白宫职务
stories.sz: 她作为新闻秘书的首次公开亮相在一片对其资质和准备工作的媒体批评声中结束。

stories.t: Sidewalk sleepers: They have nowhere else to stay while a loved one is in the hospital
stories.s: Patients travel miles to be treated at public hospitals in Delhi. Those in need get financial aid for their care. But for overnight accommodations, families are often on their own — and on the street.
stories.tz: 人行道上的露宿者：当亲人在医院治疗时，他们无处可去
stories.sz: 患者远道而来德里公立医院接受治疗。有需要的人可以获得医疗经济援助。但对于过夜住宿，家人们往往只能靠自己——露宿街头。

stories.t: France: Protesters clash with police in nationwide protests, amid rising social polarization
stories.s: Unrest broke out in parts of France as students, trade unionists and Yellow Vest activists took to the streets to protest high prices and inequality. Police arrested over 1,000 people amid chaotic scenes.
stories.tz: 法国：全国性抗议活动中示威者与警察发生冲突，社会极化加剧
stories.sz: 随着学生、工会成员和“黄马甲”活动人士走上街头抗议高物价和不平等，法国多地爆发动乱。在一片混乱中，警方逮捕了1000多人。

stories.t: ‘I cannot carry all of this alone’: the couples kept apart by the war in Gaza
stories.s: Families have been scattered, fathers separated from their children, and couples unable to reunite and marry Wijdan Abu Matar, 43, was forced to leave Gaza in November 2023 with her eight children for medical treatment, while her injured…
stories.tz: “我无法独自承载这一切”：被加沙战争拆散的夫妻
stories.sz: 许多家庭流离失所，父亲与子女骨肉分离，夫妻无法团聚并完婚。43岁的威丹·阿布·马塔尔被迫于2023年11月带着八个孩子离开加沙接受治疗，而她受伤的……

stories.t: Oregon school shooting: Police praise 'heroism' of those who intervened to stop more killing
stories.s: US police have praised the actions of three people who cut short a deadly shooting at a school in the state of Oregon. Three children and a teacher were killed in the attack, carried out by a former pupil at the school.
stories.tz: 俄勒冈州学校枪击案：警方赞扬阻止更多杀戮者的“英雄主义”行为
stories.sz: 美国警方对三名制止俄勒冈州某学校致命枪击事件的个人的英勇行为表示赞扬。袭击由该校一名往届学生实施，造成三名儿童和一名教师死亡。

stories.t: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
stories.s: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.
stories.tz: 三名男子因在墨西哥谋杀澳美冲浪者分别被判处158年监禁
stories.sz: 杰克·罗宾逊和卡伦·罗宾逊兄弟以及他们的朋友卡特·罗德在一次冲浪旅行中遇害，这似乎是一起未遂抢劫引发的谋杀。

stories.t: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
stories.s: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.
stories.tz: 关键选举临近之际，巴西亚马逊森林砍伐量创下历史新低
stories.sz: 亚马逊雨林是抵御气候变化的关键缓冲带，但在前总统雅伊尔·博索纳罗执政期间，森林砍伐规模曾一度扩大。
